packageRules.description: robolectric: released versions only. Robolectric publishes a rolling `4.17-SNAPSHOT` to Sonatype and Renovate ranks it above `4.17-beta-2`, but this build declares no snapshot repository (nor should it, for a reproducible build) — so the bump resolves nowhere and fails every Android configuration. Kept deliberately even though the pruned catalog no longer carries Robolectric: this repository grows as modules move across, and the guard costs nothing until one of them needs it. The same applies to the other ceiling rules in compose-ai-tools' .github/renovate.json (compose-bom, material-kolor, coil3, compottie, org.jetbrains.compose, androidx.core, slf4j-nop) — port the matching one WITH the dependency whenever an entry comes back into libs.versions.toml. Eight PRs past those floors were opened and closed here before the catalog was pruned; every one of them had green CI, because nothing compiled against the dependency it bumped.
